title: manettia alba
intro: Manettia alba, commonly known as White Jamaica Dogwood, is a plant species in the family Rubiaceae. It is a flowering plant native to the tropical regions of Central and South America and is valued for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Manettia alba include its ability to treat fever, rheumatism, and gastrointestinal issues, while its therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antibacterial activities. The bioactive constituents of Manettia alba include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
